estados.title: States to extract
estados.description: Which process states to fetch. AP = upcoming openings, ET = in progress, CO = concluded/awarded.

fetchDetail.title: Fetch full detail per process
fetchDetail.description: When enabled (default), fetches each process's detail page for full description, rubros, organism and direct document links (pliego, resolucion, etc). Disable for a faster, listing-only run.

maxItems.title: Max processes to extract
maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of processes returned this run, across all selected states.
